#include<cstdio>

using namespace std;
const int MOD=1000000007;
const int MAXK=33;
struct Mat{
    long long cell[MAXK][MAXK];
};
Mat base_transforms[MAXK]={};
Mat productaccumulator={{}};
Mat prefix_products[MAXK]={};
Mat suffix_products[MAXK]={};
long long number_input;
int base_input;
inline void multiply_matrices(const Mat& first, const Mat& second, Mat& result){
    Mat temp_matrix={{}};
    for(int row=0;row<=base_input;++row){
        for(int column=0;column<=base_input;++column){
            temp_matrix.cell[row][column]=0;
            for(int intermediate=0;intermediate<=base_input;++intermediate){
                temp_matrix.cell[row][column]=(temp_matrix.cell[row][column]+first.cell[row][intermediate]*second.cell[intermediate][column])%MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    result=temp_matrix;
}
void initialize(){
    cin>>number_input>>base_input;
    for(int row=0;row<=base_input;++row){
        for(int col=0;col<=base_input;++col){
            productaccumulator.cell[row][col]=(row==col)?1:0;
        }
    }
    for(int idx=0;idx<base_input;++idx){
        for(int row=0;row<=base_input;++row){
            for(int col=0;col<=base_input;++col){
                base_transforms[idx].cell[row][col]=(row==col || row==idx)?1:0;
            }
        }
    }
}
void compute(){
    vector<int> digitsequence;
    long long temp=number_input;
    while(temp>0){
        digitsequence.push_back(temp%base_input);
        temp/=base_input;
    }
    digitsequence.push_back(0);
    partial_sum(digitsequence.rbegin(),digitsequence.rend(),digitsequence.rbegin());
    for(size_t stage=0;stage<digitsequence.size()-1;++stage){
        int currentval=digitsequence[stage];
        int nextval=digitsequence[stage+1];
        for(int val=currentval-1;val>=nextval;--val){
            multiply_matrices(base_transforms[val%base_input],productaccumulator,productaccumulator);
        }
        prefix_products[0]=base_transforms[0];
        for(int i=1;i<base_input;i++){
            multiply_matrices(prefix_products[i-1],base_transforms[i],prefix_products[i]);
        }
        suffix_products[base_input-1]=base_transforms[base_input-1];
        for(int i=base_input-2;i>=0;--i){
            multiply_matrices(base_transforms[i],suffix_products[i+1],suffix_products[i]);
        }

        for(int i=1;i<base_input;i++){

        }

    long long accum=0;
    for(int row=0;row<=base_input;++row){
        accum+=productaccumulator.cell[row][base_input];
    }
    long long final_result=accum%MOD;
    if(final_result<0)final_result+=MOD;
    printf("%lld\n",final_result);

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

constexpr int MOD=1000000007;
constexpr int KMAX=33;
struct Matrix {
    long long m[KMAX][KMAX];
    Matrix() { memset(m,0,sizeof(m)); }
};
Matrix transforms[KMAX], accumulator, prefix[KMAX], suffix[KMAX];
long long N;
int B;
inline void matmul(const Matrix& a, const Matrix& b, Matrix& c) {
    Matrix tmp;
    for (int i = 0; i <= B; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j <= B; ++j) {
            tmp.m[i][j] = 0;
            for (int p = 0; p <= B; ++p)
                tmp.m[i][j] = (tmp.m[i][j] + a.m[i][p] * b.m[p][j]) % MOD;
        }
    c = tmp;
}
void setup() {
    cin >> N >> B;
    for (int i = 0; i <= B; ++i)
        accumulator.m[i][i] = 1;
    for (int p = 0; p < B; ++p)
        for (int i = 0; i <= B; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= B; ++j)
                transforms[p].m[i][j] = (i == j || i == p) ? 1 : 0;
}
void solve() {
    vector<int> digits;
    for (long long x = N; x > 0; x /= B)
        digits.push_back(x % B);
    digits.push_back(0);
    partial_sum(digits.rbegin(), digits.rend(), digits.rbegin());
    for (size_t idx = 0; idx + 1 < digits.size(); ++idx) {
        for (int val = digits[idx] - 1; val >= digits[idx + 1]; --val)
            matmul(transforms[val % B], accumulator, accumulator);
        prefix[0] = transforms[0];
        for (int i = 1; i < B; ++i)
            matmul(prefix[i - 1], transforms[i], prefix[i]);
        suffix[B - 1] = transforms[B - 1];
        for (int i = B - 2; i >= 0; --i)
            matmul(transforms[i], suffix[i + 1], suffix[i]);
        transforms[0] = suffix[0];
        for (int i = 1; i < B; ++i)
            matmul(suffix[i], prefix[i - 1], transforms[i]);
    }
    long long total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= B; ++i)
        total = (total + accumulator.m[i][B]) % MOD;
    cout << (total % MOD + MOD) % MOD << '\n';
}
int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    setup();
    solve();
